note: Hand-written source of the chapter 9 ⚡ stage (Build B1, 17 Nov 2026). tools/build_stretch.py turns it into content/ms/stretch/x09.json. Malay: Malaysian standard, standard form first, no spoken forms, chapter 9 affix gates (di- with chapter 9 roots under the shared rules; no ber-, meN-, -kan or -i, «Dilarang merokok» is a chapter 9 sign), no faith-specific greetings, «kesulitan» only in the notice (Sam, 14 Nov: casual lines use «masalah»), «kami» for the organisers (the reader not included), «kita» for neighbours together. No Cari Benda ⚡: fewer than four of the extension nouns can be drawn clearly. All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

L-1349.en: To receive, accept: «terima tetamu» = to receive guests. Compare «terima kasih» (Ch1).
L-1349.ja: 受け取る、受け入れる：«terima tetamu»＝お客を迎える。«terima kasih»（第1課）と比べよう。

L-1620.en: buat (Ch9) + -an: made. «buatan tangan» = handmade, «buatan Jepun» = made in Japan.
L-1620.ja: buat（第9課）+ -an：〜製。«buatan tangan»＝手作り、«buatan Jepun»＝日本製。

L-1621.en: ke-an + selamat (Ch1): safety, security. «keselamatan awam» = public safety.
L-1621.ja: ke-an + selamat（第1課）：安全。«keselamatan awam»＝公共の安全。

L-1622.en: Inconvenience: formal, on notices («Kami minta maaf atas kesulitan ini.»). In everyday talk, «masalah». Taught as a whole word.
L-1622.ja: ご不便：お知らせなどの改まった言い方（«Kami minta maaf atas kesulitan ini.»）。ふだんの会話では «masalah»。ひとまとまりの単語として。

L-1623.ja: 公共の：«tandas awam»＝公衆トイレ。

L-1624.en: Fine, penalty: «denda lima ratus ringgit» = a 500-ringgit fine.
L-1624.ja: 罰金：«denda lima ratus ringgit»＝罰金500リンギット。

L-1625.en: Decoration; taught as a whole word.
L-1625.ja: 飾り（ひとまとまりの単語として）。

L-1626.en: A feast, a celebratory meal for guests (a wedding, a family celebration).
L-1626.ja: 祝宴、お祝いの食事会（結婚式、家族のお祝い）。

L-1627.en: Starting from (formal, on notices): «mulai Isnin» = from Monday.
L-1627.ja: 〜から（お知らせなどの改まった言い方）：«mulai Isnin»＝月曜日から。

L-1628.en: pe(N)- + duduk (Ch4): resident. «penduduk kondo» = the condo's residents.
L-1628.ja: pe(N)- + duduk（第4課）：住民。«penduduk kondo»＝コンドミニアムの住民。

L-1630.en: Performance, show; taught as a whole word.
L-1630.ja: 公演、出し物（ひとまとまりの単語として）。

L-1631.en: To welcome, receive; to celebrate: «sambut tetamu» = to welcome guests.
L-1631.ja: 迎える；祝う：«sambut tetamu»＝お客を迎える。

L-1632.en: Until, up to: «sehingga pukul sebelas» = until eleven. Compare «hingga» (Ch9).
L-1632.ja: 〜まで：«sehingga pukul sebelas»＝11時まで。«hingga»（第9課）と比べよう。

L-1633.ja: ふさぐ、止める。«disekat»＝通行止めの。

L-1634.en: sekat + -an: a block, restriction. «sekatan jalan» = roadblock.
L-1634.ja: sekat + -an：規制、通行止め。«sekatan jalan»＝道路の通行止め。

L-1636.ja: しるし、記号。«papan tanda»（第9課）＝看板。

frames.example: Jalan ini ditutup mulai pukul enam petang sehingga pukul sebelas malam.
frames.meaning_en: This road is closed from 6 p.m. until 11 p.m.
frames.meaning_ja: この道は午後6時から午後11時まで通行止めです。

frames.example: Kami minta maaf atas kesulitan ini.
frames.meaning_ja: ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。
公共の安全のため、立ち入り禁止。

frames.example: Dilarang merokok di sini. Denda lima ratus ringgit.
frames.meaning_ja: ここは禁煙。罰金500リンギット。

frames.example: Tuan rumah sambut tetamu di pintu.
frames.meaning_en: The host welcomes the guests at the door.
frames.meaning_ja: ホストが玄関でお客を迎えます。
このケーキは母の手作りです。

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Puan Siti, tolong baca papan tanda ini. Saya belum faham.
lines.en: Mrs Siti, could you read this sign for me? I don't understand it yet.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Jalan ini ditutup mulai pukul enam petang, Sabtu ini.
lines.en: This road is closed from six in the evening, this Saturday.
choices: Jalan ini dibuka mulai pukul enam petang, Sabtu lepas.
Dilarang makan dan minum di jalan ini.
choices_en: This road was open from six in the evening last Saturday.
No eating or drinking on this road.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Ada pesta penduduk. Ada pentas dan persembahan muzik.
lines.en: There's a residents' festival. There'll be a stage and music performances.
choices: Saya tidak tahu. Saya tidak suka pesta.
choices_en: I don't know. I don't like festivals.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.en: Yes! All the residents are invited.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ada sekatan jalan? Kereta saya di tempat letak kereta.
lines.en: Is there a roadblock? My car is in the car park.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Ya, sehingga pukul sebelas malam. Kalau letak kereta di jalan itu, ada denda.
lines.en: Yes, until eleven at night. If you park on that road, there's a fine.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Baik, saya tidak bawa kereta. Terima kasih, Puan.
lines.en: All right, I won't take the car. Thank you.
choices: Baik, saya letak kereta di jalan itu.
choices_en: All right, I'll park on that road.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka! Hiasan di pentas itu buatan tangan penduduk.
lines.en: Mr Tanaka! The decorations on that stage were made by hand by the residents.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Cantik sekali! Persembahan mula pukul berapa?
lines.en: They're beautiful! What time does the show start?
choices: Kotor sekali! Siapa buat hiasan itu?
choices_en: How dirty! Who made those decorations?
How many ringgit is the fine?

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Pukul lapan. Anak saya ada persembahan muzik di pentas.
lines.en: At eight. My child is performing music on the stage.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.en: Wow, congratulations! I want to watch.
choices_en: Wow, congratulations! I want to sleep.
